the_day: Anthropic filed to go public and reportedly lined up $63 billion in Broadcom financing, OpenAI expanded its Oracle partnership and was sued by Texas, Google announced Genie 4, Meta plans a $95 billion stock sale, and SpaceX secured $40 billion for AI chips.

items.headline: Anthropic files to go public, showing large losses and fast-growing revenue
points: Anthropic filed its IPO paperwork, which shows about $80 billion in losses alongside surging revenue, Axios and The Washington Post report.
CNN reports the filing includes a risk section of nearly 100 pages, covering harms from bioweapons to blackmail.
Barron's reports the seven founders will hold majority control, and Yahoo Finance says the shares will list on Nasdaq.
items.for_you: If you build on Claude, the filing is the most detailed public account so far of Anthropic's finances, risks and governance.

The WSJ reports Broadcom's CEO stepped in personally to close the debt deal.

items.headline: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model for interactive simulation
points: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a new world model that generates interactive simulations in real time.
TechCrunch reports it adds audio, more realistic worlds and the ability to steer the simulation as it runs.
Bloomberg notes that the previous version shook video game stocks.

items.headline: Meta plans $95 billion stock sale, with Nvidia and AMD investing
points: Meta plans to raise up to $95 billion through two stock offerings to pay for its AI expansion, several outlets report.
Nvidia will invest $3 billion in new Meta shares as part of a partnership around Meta's AI agent Muse, BigGo Finance reports.
TradingView reports AMD will invest $1 billion, and AMD announced a wider infrastructure partnership with Meta.

items.headline: OpenAI and Oracle expand partnership to bring Oracle apps into ChatGPT
points: Oracle business applications and AI agents are coming into ChatGPT, and Oracle will build ChatGPT and Codex into its own products.
Oracle also announced an AI Security Mesh that uses OpenAI's cyber models to find vulnerabilities.
Unite.AI counts four new enterprise offerings from the expanded partnership.
items.for_you: If your company runs Oracle business software, ChatGPT and Codex features are coming into those apps.

items.headline: Researchers bypass OpenAI protections meant to keep model reasoning hidden
points: Researchers used a flaw in OpenAI's compaction feature to expose model reasoning that is meant to stay hidden, The Hacker News and Infosecurity Magazine report.
CSO Online reports that researchers quickly got around an August fix against theft of reasoning traces.

items.headline: SpaceX secures $40 billion financing commitment for AI chips
points: SpaceX secured a $40 billion GPU financing commitment for its AI business, Crowdfund Insider and ProPakistani report, after reports yesterday of complications.
Free Malaysia Today describes the deal as an AI chip lease.
Fortune reports Musk warned that more than 200 AI cloud companies could fail as financing tightens.
